mapping.designScopeHint: Design belongs to this product (Product ID + Seller SKU). Uploading or replacing a file updates EVERY order not yet sent to production — including orders synced later. Deleting sends all of them back to "design missing". Orders already sent keep the files they were sent with.
mapping.keyRequiredHint: This product has no Product ID or Seller SKU, so it cannot be mapped. Re-sync the order from TikTok to obtain both keys.
mapping.catalogNotSynced: The catalogue has not been synced yet. Click "Sync catalogue" to pull it from the provider.
mapping.syncCatalogHint: Pull Catalogue → Product → Variant from the provider into the system. This takes a few minutes for large catalogues.
mapping.suggestionsHint: More than one result, so the system did not choose automatically — a wrong mapping is worse than none. Pick the right variant below.

title: Fulfillment

fulfill.addressCheckedHint: The recipient address is decrypted and validated on the server at submit time — the UI never shows personal data.
fulfill.baseCostPendingHint: The print shop accepted the order but has not quoted every line yet. The next sync run fills it in — no need to resend.

blocked.busy: A submission is already running — wait for it to finish.
blocked.notReadyUnknown: This order does not meet the requirements yet.
blocked.status: The order is {{status}}, so it can no longer be submitted.

config.artworkHint: Print locations sent to the provider: {{keys}}.
config.baseCostHint: Only a fallback snapshot taken at submit time. The real base cost comes from the provider after the order is created and overwrites this value.
config.missingKey: This line has no Product ID or Seller SKU, so it cannot be mapped.
config.missingVariant: No provider variant resolved yet (missing Color/Size or SKU).
config.noPrintLocations: The provider exposes no print location.
config.noProvider: The TikTok connection of this order has no fulfilment provider assigned.
config.productUnavailable: The saved product is no longer in the synced catalogue. Your configuration is kept — re-sync the catalogue or pick another product, then save.
config.productionLineHint: The submitted value is the provider line ID. One order = ONE line — two products declaring different lines are blocked before submit.

fulfill.defaultsHint: Empty field = use the configured provider default.
fulfill.designHint: Design files are resolved by Product ID + Seller SKU; the print shop downloads them from the public URL.
fulfill.dropshipUnavailable: No Dropship provider exists in this system yet; only POD orders can be sent.
fulfill.facilityHint: Only applies to the TIKTOK production line.
fulfill.failed: Could not send the order to the print shop

label.fetchFailed: Could not get the label from TikTok
label.reused: Reused the existing package — no new package was created

fulfill.labelUrlHint: Shipping label link (PDF/PNG/JPG) — the print shop downloads it, so the URL must be public.
fulfill.labelUrlInvalid: The label link must be a valid http(s) URL.
fulfill.mappingHint: Provider SKU, production config and base cost come from Product Mapping — declare once per Product ID + Seller SKU.
fulfill.maskedNeedsLabel: TikTok has hidden this order’s recipient details and no readable address is stored — the order will ship using the shipping label below.
fulfill.maskedUsingSnapshot: TikTok has hidden the recipient details in recent syncs. The address captured earlier is still stored, so this order ships normally.
fulfill.notePlaceholder: Note for the print shop. Empty ⇒ the seller note is used.
fulfill.previousAttempt: Submitted {{count}} time(s) before · last total cost: {{total}}
fulfill.providerRejected: The print shop rejected the order
fulfill.resultHint: The print shop accepted the order. Close to go back to the list.
fulfill.retryHint: A retry reuses the SAME order id, so the print shop never creates a second order.
fulfill.subtitle: Pick the options for this submission. Empty fields fall back to the fulfilment provider defaults.
